name: Alerta_Fallo_Pipeline_CICD

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_runs FROM "cicd_pipeline" WHERE status = 'failed'

description: Se activa cuando GitHub Actions detecta un fallo en Playwright/Jest y bloquea el despliegue SSH en EC2.

name: Alerta_Errores_HTTP_5xx_API

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS server_errors FROM "default" WHERE severity = 'Error' OR statuscode >= 500

description: Se activa cuando ToyStore.API registra 5 o mas errores de servidor (5xx) o excepciones en una ventana de 5 minutos.

name: Alerta_Alto_Consumo_CPU_RAM_EC2

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_load FROM "ec2_infrastructure" WHERE cpu_percent > 80 OR memory_percent > 85

description: Se activa cuando la instancia AWS EC2 supera el 80% de CPU o el 85% de Memoria RAM.
